reason: The caps should close the liner access ports and protect the surrounding ice; it is also the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the working windows to be sealed for cold storage.

effect: The case is closed and the storage goal is complete, as expected.
reaction: The closure makes practical sense, but the result feels abrupt after the significance of the discovery.

mostWorthwhile.text: Closing the liner ports connects the request to preserve the surrounding context with a concrete protective action.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sole action ends immediately with a plain creation message, so there is little to explore or experience in this chapter.

surprise.text: Nothing in the action's result surprised me; the closed case was what I expected.

arbitrary.text: The caps have a clear purpose, although the only offered action left no decision to make.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the body and its surrounding ice reach Earth, though this chapter alone offered little interactive interest.
